title: Off The Hook Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Located just 5 streets outside of Seaside and about 200 steps to the beach, Off the Hook is a beautifully renovated 3 bedroom ranch with designer kitchen details, custom bathrooms, and stylish decor throughout.
description_expanded: SPECIALS!!!! **30% off 14 night+ rentals now until end of February 2026! (Excluding Thanksgiving, Christmas and NYE)- discount will automatically be applied** HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS. - Beautiful custom ranch home, renovated from the studs, perfect for short or longer stays! - Walking distance to the town of Seaside - Easy 3-4 minute walk to several beach access locations - Private parking - 2 Beach cruiser bikes - All bedrooms have TVs - Fully Stocked Kitchen - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ON: -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) Located just 5 streets outside of Seaside and 1 block up from the beach, "Off the Hook" is a beautifully renovated 3 bedroom ranch with designer kitchen details, custom bathrooms, and stylish decor throughout. This cottage is close enough to all the fun, yet nestled among the live oaks and off the main roads a bit giving you a naturally secluded beach feel. Guests arrive to a welcoming porch on the front of the house and a screened porch the runs the length of the house. Both allow you to really enjoy beach living from your own front steps. Upon entering "Off the Hook", you're greeted with open living and dining spaces and vaulted ceilings. Custom decor featuring a wrap around sofa, flat screen TV, additional seating, and a a fun sliding barn door to give the two guest rooms some additional privacy. The eat-in kitchen offers dining space for 6 with additional bar seating for 4 more. The gourmet kitchen features stainless appliances and granite counter tops. Access to the screen porch is just off the kitchen. Down the short hallway is the king master bedroom complete with flat screen TV and private master bath. The master bath offers dual sinks, granite counter tops, and a custom tile shower. A washer/dryer completes this end of the house. Both guest rooms are just past the barn door. One is a queen guest room with flat screen TV and the other is a dual twin guest room also with flat screen TV. These two bedrooms share a guest bath with bath/shower combo. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS- everything is on the first floor - King bedroom with large TV, direct access to across the hall to bath (shower only) - Separate hall with barn door privacy takes you to second and third bedrooms - Queen bedroom with TV - Bunk room with 4 twins (sleeps up to 4), TV - Shared hall bath (tub/shower combo) So hang up your belongings, and throw back your 's time to pretend you're "Off the Hook" ...even if it's just for a little while! Sorry, no pets Must be 25 + to rent FREE WiFi

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
